mapper.select: SELECT id,task_type,status,error_msg,start_time,end_time FROM lx_sync_task_h WHERE task_type='incremental' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count, MIN(updated_until) AS min_updated_until, MAX(updated_until) AS max_updated_until FROM lx_sync_state_h WHERE source_code IN ('plan','order','receipt','request_funds','funds_pool')
SELECT start_time FROM lx_sync_task_h WHERE task_type='incremental' AND status='success' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.plan_sn,p.sid, p.cg_uid AS purchaser_uid, p.cg_opt_username AS purchaser_name, COALESCE(h.create_time,l.created_at) AS created_at FROM lx_sync_document_h d JOIN JSON_TABLE(d.raw_payload,'$[*]' COLUMNS ( plan_sn VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.plan_sn', sid BIGINT PATH '$.sid', cg_uid BIGINT PATH '$.cg_uid', cg_opt_username VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.cg_opt_username', status INT PATH '$.status')) p ON TRUE JOIN lx_purchase_plan_h h ON h.plan_sn=p.plan_sn LEFT JOIN (SELECT business_id,MIN(ol_time) AS created_at FROM lx_business_log_h WHERE ol_type_text='创建' AND business_id LIKE '1_PP%' GROUP BY business_id) l ON l.business_id=CONCAT('1_',p.plan_sn) WHERE d.business_id=CONCAT('1_',p.plan_sn) AND p.status IN (2,3) AND p.sid IN #{sid} AND (COALESCE(h.create_time,l.created_at)>=#{createdFrom} OR COALESCE(h.create_time,l.created_at) IS NULL) ORDER BY created_at,p.plan_sn,p.sid
SELECT business_id,ol_time,ol_type_text,ol_detail,ol_uid,realname FROM lx_business_log_h ORDER BY ol_time,business_id

SELECT order_sn,sku,follower_name,expected_delivery_date,reason,remark,NULL AS group_key FROM reminder_excel_import
order_sn IN #{poSn}

SELECT order_sn,business_order_sn AS po_sn,status FROM lx_receipt_order_h
business_order_sn IN #{poSn}
SELECT cookies FROM lx_cookies_cache ORDER BY cookie_date DESC LIMIT 1
